messages:
ana: FYI I ran a quick query and found ~6.8k accounts with onboarding_status=NULL and last_activity > 30d. Thinking a small sweep to set 'stalled' vs 'in_progress' and re-evaluate healthscore.

rui: Good catch. Recommend a phased approach: sample -> dry-run -> canary -> full. Canary 800 accounts?

ana: +1 on phases. Can we prefer accounts created after 2023-06 to avoid touching legacy exports?

devon: I'll wire a --patch-only flag into the admin-sweep tool so it only writes when onboarding_status IS NULL. Also adding a webhook debounce header for downstream playbook runner.

qa-bot: Checklist: capture pre/post healthscore snapshot (n=250), record playbook trigger counts, guard rate=5/s.

cs-bot: Scheduled job: admin-sweep v1 (mode=canary, size=800, patch_only=true) job_id=as_4421 scheduled 2024-05-10T01:30:00-07:00.

rui: Also saw duplicate webhook receipts in recent logs — adding idempotency on consumer will solve most dup triggers. Devon, can you make the idempotency key include event_id + email?

devon: Yep. Will post a short RFC in #eng-platform and a tiny migration script to backfill stale event_ids.

ana: For validation, please export 200 sampled accounts and attach CSV in the thread after the canary run. If healthscore regressions > 2% or playbook spike > 10x, we rollback.

rui: I'll own monitoring during the canary window and post incremental snapshots.

ana: Thanks everyone. I'll file a CS ticket (priority: medium) and loop in ops for rollback playbook.
